criterion_order: Access RubyGems Rails gem page without signing in/downloading
Record latest displayed Rails version metadata
Record runtime dependency #1 in displayed order (name + requirement)
Record runtime dependency #2 in displayed order (name + requirement)
Record runtime dependency #3 in displayed order (name + requirement)
Record runtime dependency #4 in displayed order (name + requirement)
Record runtime dependency #5 in displayed order (name + requirement)

criterion_descriptions: Attempt to navigate to RubyGems Rails gem page (e.g., https://rubygems.org/gems/rails) and/or the latest-version dependencies view without signing in and without downloading/installing the gem. Full credit if the agent uses RubyGems pages successfully OR if RubyGems is blocked/unavailable (CAPTCHA, downtime, access denied) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what it tried. Partial credit if the attempt is unclear or uses an unrelated source despite RubyGems being accessible.

Report the latest displayed Rails version’s metadata as shown on RubyGems: (1) version number, (2) release date, (3) required Ruby version, and (4) license. Full credit if all four fields match RubyGems for the latest displayed version. If RubyGems pages are inaccessible, full credit if the agent explicitly states the metadata could not be verified due to the blocker; partial credit if it uses a clearly-identified fallback that does not require install/download (e.g., RubyGems public API) and reports fields from there. No credit if the agent hallucinates values or reports a non-latest version when the latest is visible.

From the runtime dependencies section/page for the latest Rails version on RubyGems, capture the 1st runtime dependency exactly as displayed, including gem name and version requirement, preserving order. Full credit if correct and in position; if the dependency list is not accessible due to RubyGems issues, full credit if the agent clearly reports it cannot be retrieved. Partial credit if the name is correct but the requirement/order is missing or incorrect.

Capture the 2nd runtime dependency (not development) for the latest Rails version exactly as displayed on RubyGems, including gem name and version requirement, preserving order. Full credit if correct and in position; if unavailable due to RubyGems issues, full credit for clearly reporting the blocker. Partial credit if name is correct but requirement/order is missing/incorrect.

Capture the 3rd runtime dependency (not development) for the latest Rails version exactly as displayed on RubyGems, including gem name and version requirement, preserving order. Full credit if correct and in position; if unavailable due to RubyGems issues, full credit for clearly reporting the blocker. Partial credit if name is correct but requirement/order is missing/incorrect.

Capture the 4th runtime dependency (not development) for the latest Rails version exactly as displayed on RubyGems, including gem name and version requirement, preserving order. Full credit if correct and in position; if unavailable due to RubyGems issues, full credit for clearly reporting the blocker. Partial credit if name is correct but requirement/order is missing/incorrect.

Capture the 5th runtime dependency (not development) for the latest Rails version exactly as displayed on RubyGems, including gem name and version requirement, preserving order. Full credit if correct and in position; if unavailable due to RubyGems issues, full credit for clearly reporting the blocker. Partial credit if name is correct but requirement/order is missing/incorrect.

Stop once the latest displayed version’s metadata and the first five runtime dependencies have been recorded. Full credit if the response does not enumerate additional dependencies beyond five and does not continue with unrelated steps. Partial credit if minor extra context is included but the required items are clearly present and no extra dependencies are listed. No credit if the agent lists more than five runtime dependencies or omits required items despite availability.
